findings.problem: The sentence has no conjugated verb, and the rules say the example must conjugate one.
findings.fix: example.es: Muchas gracias, me ayudaste mucho. example.en: Thank you very much, you helped me a lot.

back.example: Thank you very much for your help.

note: Gracias also means "thanks", so the learner could accept either English prompt, but both still lead to the same single Spanish answer.
